handbook.noirm.welcome.body:
This handbook is yours. Read it whenever you're lost; chapters are on the left (arrow keys or click), and the wheel scrolls a page.

You start as an Academy student in plain clothes. Everything else is earned: stats from training and real fights, jutsu from practice, scrolls and masters, natures from long drills, money and rank from missions.

A good first day: switch on combat mode and hit a training dummy, open your jutsu with J, then walk to a village and find its missions board.
handbook.noirm.controls.body:
Fighting happens in combat mode: switch it on, and your mouse buttons become strikes. Combos chain when you press again quickly. Sprint + click is a dash attack, holding back (S) + click a back attack, crouch + heavy a launcher.

A guard raised right as a hit lands is a parry; a dodge right as it lands is a perfect dodge. Grabs beat a guard.

These are your keys right now (change them in Options → Controls → NOIRM):
handbook.noirm.stats.body:
Seven stats make a shinobi. Speed: how fast you move and how slow everyone else looks. Taijutsu: how hard your body hits. Vitality: your health. Reserves: your chakra. Chakra control (CTL): cheaper jutsu, easier water walking. Willpower (WIL): resisting strain. Durability (DUR): a share of every hit you shrug off, up to 60%.

How they grow: hitting the training dummy trains taijutsu and speed, running trains speed, meditating trains reserves, taking hits trains durability. Drills stop teaching at 30: past that only real fights teach, and stronger foes teach more.

Kill XP: beating a ninja gives XP to the stats you used most in that fight (punches, dodges, jutsu, the hits you took), more for a stronger enemy.
handbook.noirm.natures.body:
Your clan gives you one or two natures (fire, water, wind, lightning, earth) and their first jutsu. Others take days of work.

Chakra paper: hold right-click and it reacts to your nature (it splits, burns, gets wet, crinkles or crumbles). A faint second reaction shows a hidden nature: those train twice as fast.

Drills: meditate in the nature's setting. Wind: hold a leaf block. Fire: sit by a flame. Water: by running water or in the rain. Lightning: by a lightning rod or in a storm. Earth: on bare stone, surrounded by stone. A drill is about three in-game days. A crew mate or master who has the nature, sitting near you, speeds it up. /noirm drills shows your progress.
handbook.noirm.scrolls.body:
Every cast earns mastery (★). At ★2 a jutsu teaches the next one in its line, once your chakra can hold it (a B-rank jutsu needs Reserves 15, A 25, S 40; until then it waits and comes by itself). Put up to four jutsu in your loadout with the jutsu screen.

Jutsu scrolls (rank C, B, A, S) come from chests, beaten ninjas and village scroll shops. Reading one teaches a jutsu of that rank of a nature you own. Bigger ranks need more chakra (B: Reserves 15, A: 25, S: 40) and a higher rank (B: chūnin, A: jōnin, S: ANBU).

Nature scrolls are rare: they put a quarter of a nature drill behind you.
handbook.noirm.missions.body:
Every village has a missions board. Right-click it to see the jobs: hunt rogues, escort, deliver, scout. Finish one, report back to any board, and you're paid in ryo and rank points. (Crouch and right-click a board with an empty hand for a new handbook.)

Ryo is your wallet: shops sell in ryo, masters charge for lessons. /noirm ryo shows it; /noirm ryo withdraw puts some in a pouch to hand over.

Rank: Academy → genin → chūnin → jōnin. With enough points, the board offers a rank-up exam (a test spar, a chūnin tournament, a lone hunt and a jōnin). ANBU and Kage candidate come by invitation, after hard missions. Higher ranks open missions, better gear and masters' lessons.
handbook.noirm.crew.body:
Beat a ninja down below a quarter of their health and they yield (kneel). Right-click them to invite them into your crew.

Right-click a crew mate for the ally screen: their gear, what they hold, their orders, style and look, and the jutsu and natures you teach them. Crouch + right-click: wait / follow. The crew orders key gives the whole crew orders at once (posts, come here, fall back, jobs like medic or scout).

Respect matters: winning together and giving gear raises it, hitting them lowers it. Too low and they leave.
handbook.noirm.masters.body:
Masters test you, then teach what no scroll can. Right-click one to talk. Lessons ask for stats, practice, a rank and ryo.

Might Guy, at a Leaf village's training ground: a spar, then the Strong Fist and the Eight Gates.

Rensai the Scholar, in a hidden village's Academy: a jutsu duel, then faster hand seals, cheaper jutsu, a jutsu for each nature, and Nature Insight. Meditate near him to drill any of the five natures twice as fast.

Tsubaki, the Hospital Medic, in a hidden village's hospital: keep a patient alive, then Healing Palm, the Chakra Scalpel, Poison Lore (working antidotes) and safe eye transplants.

The Stone Hermit lives far from any village: see the Sage Mode chapter.
handbook.noirm.sage.body:
Meditating slowly fills you with nature energy. A hermit in a remote sanctuary teaches how to use it (/noirm sage rumour gives a hint where).

His test is stillness: meditate by his pool while restless spirits try to break your focus. Then he teaches you to gather nature energy, to purge it, and finally Sage Mode: pigment marks around your eyes and a strong boost while the energy lasts.

Careful: take in more than your chakra control can hold and your body turns to stone, from the hands up. Let the excess go before it's too late.
handbook.noirm.bingo.body:
Every ninja has a class from D (weak) to S (deadly), shown with their name. Stronger classes are far more dangerous and give far more XP.

The bingo book lists the most dangerous rogues in the world, with a bounty in ryo on each head. Some of them are legends: you'll know them when you see them.

Don't hunt above your class alone.

Get one for 60 ryo at a general store or weapon shop, or with the "Buy bingo book" button on a missions board. The village hands you one when you become chūnin. Your class isn't your rank: rank is your standing in the village, class is how strong you are.
handbook.noirm.beasts.body:
Tailed beasts roam the world. Beat one down until it lies subdued, then use a Sealing Scroll on it; use the full scroll on yourself to become its jinchūriki, or on someone else. Some are born with a beast inside. Your bond with the beast decides how many tails you can draw safely.

Dōjutsu: Hyūga are born with the Byakugan (see through walls, chakra points). Uchiha awaken the Sharingan near death or in great loss; it grows only in real fights, and can become the Mangekyō. Eyes taken from a fallen Uchiha can be transplanted: do it at a hospital, because operating on yourself can ruin the eye.

handbook.noirm.reinforcement.body:
Ninjas fight through armour. Against a ninja's strikes, thrown weapons, jutsu and the fire they light, vanilla armour (and its enchantments) keeps only a quarter of its usual protection: diamond still helps a little, but it won't save you. Zombies, skeletons and the other vanilla monsters still meet your armour in full.

Chakra reinforcement is the real defence. Your Reserves and chakra control (CTL) lay chakra over your body and your gear: the more you have, the harder your strikes and weapons hit (up to +50%) and the less ninja attacks hurt you (up to -35%). It stacks with Durability, but the two together never stop more than 70% of a hit.

It costs a little chakra every time: about a point for each reinforced strike you land, and a little for each hit it softens (good CTL makes both cheaper). Out of chakra, you fight unreinforced. In combat mode the HUD shows "Chakra armour" and its bonus, in blue while you have the chakra for it; a faint blue sheen marks a reinforced hit. Enemy ninjas reinforce themselves the same way, from their own chakra.

Your armour holds chakra too. Every piece you wear gets a pool of chakra durability (up to half its own) that takes the wear before the item does and slowly refills from your chakra. The tooltip shows it as "Durability 340/528 + 120 chakra", and a thin blue line over the item's durability bar shows how full it is.

Fire: an enemy ninja's fire burns you for a shorter time, and in any one second it can't take more than about a third of your health, so a beginner caught by a fireball has time to run for water. Two or three in a row still kill.

handbook.noirm.medicine.body:
Good food does more than fill you. Onigiri and grilled fish quicken your stamina, pork ramen your chakra, spicy beef ramen makes training stick, plum onigiri and dango steady your posture, curry heals a little. Cook rice in a furnace, smoker or campfire; ramen shops and teahouses sell the rest.

Pills are a medic's craft. Gather herbs: moonroot (forests and taiga), bloodleaf (jungles, swamps, dark forests), ironmillet (plains, savanna), mistcap (meadows, groves, windswept hills) and the rare ashthorn (badlands). Break a ripe one for the herb and seeds; they grow on grass, and fast on farmland. Florists sell seeds.

Craft an Apothecary and right-click it. Click a recipe to fill the mortar from your bag, then Grind. Your pharmacology decides the success chance, the grade (crude, standard, refined, perfect) and how many you get. A failed brew leaves a ruined pill. Brewing trains pharmacology.

Every pill has a cooldown and adds toxicity. Pills taken on top of others work less, and too many make you sick. Strong pills crash: the soldier pill leaves you slow and weak, the three-seal pill punishes you for twice as long as it helps.

New recipes: Tsubaki the medic (Pill Lore, and High-Grade Pills for jōnin), medical scrolls from old chests, strong rogues and scroll shops. Shops and missions pay in pills too, and rogues carry a few: they will swallow them mid-fight.

style.noirm.iron_body.desc: Rooted and armoured. The guard keeps out almost everything and shrugs off posture, but you plod; heavy blows push through hits.
style.noirm.viper.desc: Low and fast. Finger jabs at pressure points knock the breath out: every hit drains stamina. Slides to dodge.
style.noirm.crane.desc: High on one leg. Long kicks, a light guard with a wider parry, a hop for a dodge, and +35% damage from the air.
style.noirm.mountain.desc: A deep, rooted stance. Slow on your feet, but the guard is a counter stance: a huge parry window that answers at once.
style.noirm.wind_step.desc: Bouncing and quick. You never block: guard is a sway out of the way. Light strikes that spring back out of reach.
style.noirm.shadow.desc: Low, a hand hidden. Feint with guard during your wind-up, then strike through their guard; +60% from behind.
style.noirm.leaf_hurricane.desc: Strong Fist's whirling cousin. Spinning kicks that build momentum with every hit of a string; flips to dodge.
style.noirm.sumo.desc: Wide and heavy. Open-hand thrusts that shove, a belt grab into lifts and throws, an armoured guard, charges that keep going.
style.noirm.monkey.desc: Crouched and twitchy. Swipes, low sweeps, cartwheels and backflip kicks; flips to dodge; the spinning sweep goes under a guard.
style.noirm.blade_iai.desc: Katana and sword: crouched, blade low. A counter stance with a wide parry answered by a drawing cut; draws slip through guards.
style.noirm.blade_dance.desc: Sword, tantō and kunai: light and flowing. Spinning cuts that build momentum, flips to dodge, deeper cuts from behind.
style.noirm.staff_wall.desc: Staff: square and high. A guard like a wall, long thrusts and sweeps that push people away, an overhead crash.
style.noirm.spear_dance.desc: Yari: bouncing, spear low and long. Hit and run: thrusts that spring back out of reach, vaults and hops.
style.noirm.basic.desc: The Academy's all-round style: jabs, kicks and a solid guard.
style.noirm.brawler.desc: Elbows, knees and headbutts at close range; grabs into the clinch.
style.noirm.strong_fist.desc: Fast, powerful kicks and the Leaf techniques. Needs taijutsu 18.
style.noirm.gentle_fist.desc: Palms at the chakra network: they slip through guards and drain chakra. Needs the Byakugan.
message.noirm.style.learned.master: Your master taught you a new fighting style: %s. Press I to choose styles.
message.noirm.style.learned.scroll: The scroll teaches you a new fighting style: %s. Press I to choose styles.
message.noirm.style.learned.watch: Watching that fight, something clicks: you picked up %s. Press I to choose styles.
message.noirm.style.learned.clan: Your clan passes its fighting style on to you: %s. Press I to choose styles.
message.noirm.style.scroll_nothing: You already know every style a scroll could teach.
item.noirm.style_scroll.tip: A fighting style you don't know yet. Use it to read it.
help.noirm.combat.style_learn: learn a fighting style (or all of them) as if a master taught it
screen.noirm.styles.title: Fighting styles
screen.noirm.styles.locked.learn: Not learned yet: masters, style scrolls in chests, or watching someone who fights this way.
screen.noirm.styles.hint: Click a style to use it. H cycles your unarmed styles.
perk.noirm.chakra_pool.desc: Your whole chakra pool grows by this share.
perk.noirm.max_stamina.desc: More stamina for guarding, dodging and running.
perk.noirm.health_regen.desc: Health you regain every second, on top of normal healing (while not starving).
perk.noirm.posture.desc: How much pressure your guard takes before it breaks.
perk.noirm.perception.desc: Enemy attacks look slower to you.
perk.noirm.sensor.desc: Crouch to concentrate: a radar shows the chakra around you.
perk.noirm.sealing_power.desc: Stronger sealing jutsu; beasts settle in calmer when you seal them; a master sealer can capture a badly hurt beast and may keep the scroll.
perk.noirm.mastery.desc: Your jutsu level up faster with use.
perk.noirm.start_speed.desc: Added to your speed when the character is made.
perk.noirm.start_taijutsu.desc: Added to your taijutsu when the character is made.
perk.noirm.start_reserves.desc: Added to your reserves when the character is made.
perk.noirm.start_control.desc: Added to your chakra control when the character is made.
perk.noirm.start_willpower.desc: Added to your willpower when the character is made.
perk.noirm.start_vitality.desc: Added to your vitality when the character is made.
perk.noirm.start_durability.desc: Added to your durability when the character is made.
perk.noirm.damage_taken.desc: Every kind of damage you take.
perk.noirm.dot_resist.desc: Less damage from poison, wither, burning and bleeding.
perk.noirm.poison_immunity.desc: Poison and wither don't take hold.
perk.noirm.water_dodge.desc: In water, in the rain or near a river, a blow or a projectile can pass straight through you.
perk.noirm.phase_dodge.desc: Anywhere, a blow or a projectile can pass straight through you.
perk.noirm.chakra_leech.desc: Each blow on a chakra user eats their chakra; half comes back to you.
perk.noirm.genjutsu_resist.desc: Less chance to be caught in an illusion.
perk.noirm.strain.desc: How fast the Mangekyō wears your eyes.
perk.noirm.pill_toxicity.desc: How much toxicity each pill leaves.
perk.noirm.beast_bond.desc: A sealed tailed beast comes to trust you faster.
perk.noirm.gentle_fist.desc: Gentle Fist hits drain more chakra and close more points.
perk.noirm.combo_affinity.desc: Combined natures you unlock (Wood, Ice…) come out stronger.
perk.noirm.crew_respect.desc: Crew mates come to respect you faster.
perk.noirm.hound.desc: A ninja hound partner that grows with you (Inuzuka start with a puppy, Hatake with a summoning contract).
perk.noirm.late_bloomer.desc: Stats under 30 train 25% slower; from 30 on, 60% faster.
talent.noirm.prodigy.desc: Jutsu click for you: each one masters twice as fast.
talent.noirm.taijutsu_genius.desc: Your body learns fighting fast, and your blows land heavier.
talent.noirm.chakra_sensor.desc: You feel chakra from far away. Crouch to sense who is near, even unseen.
talent.noirm.iron_will.desc: Illusions slide off a mind like yours, and you never give up.
talent.noirm.quick_learner.desc: Every kind of training sticks a little faster.
talent.noirm.late_bloomer.desc: A slow start, then you outgrow everyone: weak training below 30, great training past it.
talent.noirm.frail_but_precise.desc: A fragile body, but your jutsu are sharper and you read fights better.
talent.noirm.glutton.desc: Food does more for you than for anyone.
talent.noirm.pill_prodigy.desc: A natural apothecary: pharmacology comes fast, pills work better and sit easier.
talent.noirm.stubborn_body.desc: You shrug off hits other people feel: higher Durability that grows fast.
talent.noirm.fleet_footed.desc: Quick from the start and quicker every day.
talent.noirm.natural_sealer.desc: Seals come easily to your hands: cheaper and stronger sealing, beasts trust you sooner.
talent.noirm.hot_blooded.desc: You hit hard and burn bright in a fight, but patient chakra control isn't your thing.
talent.noirm.cursed_luck.desc: Hits find you and pills sit badly, but misfortune hardens you.
talent.noirm.deep_reserves.desc: A bigger chakra pool than most, refilling a little faster.
talent.noirm.quick_recovery.desc: You catch your breath fast and heal a little on your own.
talent.noirm.keen_eyes.desc: You see attacks coming a little earlier.
talent.noirm.fine_control.desc: You mould chakra precisely: cheaper jutsu and more chakra control.
talent.noirm.strategist.desc: A sharp mind: control, willpower and jutsu mastery grow fast.
talent.noirm.tough_as_nails.desc: More health, and poison and burns bother you less.
talent.noirm.shaky_control.desc: Your chakra slips through your fingers: jutsu cost more.
talent.noirm.sickly.desc: A weak constitution: less health, and illness lingers.
talent.noirm.easygoing.desc: You don't push yourself, so you train slower, but you never run out of breath or chakra.
talent.noirm.genjutsu_talent.desc: Your illusions run deeper than others'.
talent.noirm.healing_hands.desc: A gift for medical ninjutsu, and your own wounds close faster.
talent.noirm.kindred_spirit.desc: Beasts and comrades take to you: faster beast bond and crew respect.
talent.noirm.born_leader.desc: People follow you: crew respect grows fast and you hold firm.
talent.noirm.heavy_handed.desc: Your blows land like hammers, but you're not built for speed.
talent.noirm.glass_jaw.desc: Your guard gives way sooner and hits hurt more.
clan.noirm.uzumaki.desc: Long-lived sealing masters with enormous chakra and fast healing. Red hair runs in the family.
clan.noirm.uchiha.desc: The Sharingan clan: fire, sharp eyes and strong feelings. Their eyes carry a curse: the Mangekyō wears them faster.
clan.noirm.hyuga.desc: The Byakugan and the Gentle Fist: fine chakra control and hits that close chakra points. Weaker ninjutsu.
clan.noirm.senju.desc: Vast vitality and stamina, fast healing, a gift for medicine and for Wood. Rough chakra control.
clan.noirm.nara.desc: Shadow users and strategists: great chakra control, fast learners. Not fond of hard physical work.
clan.noirm.akimichi.desc: Big, tough and strong; food fuels them like no one else. They grow huge in battle. Slow on their feet.
clan.noirm.yamanaka.desc: Mind techniques and sensing: sharp perception and steady minds, in lighter bodies.
clan.noirm.aburame.desc: Hosts to chakra-eating insects: immune to poison, they sense others and drain chakra with every hit. Fire hurts them.
clan.noirm.inuzuka.desc: Fighters who run with ninja hounds: a sharp nose, speed and wild strikes. Every member starts with a hound.
clan.noirm.hatake.desc: A small line of geniuses: quick learners and fast, often with ninja hounds. Smaller chakra reserves.
clan.noirm.sarutobi.desc: A clan of leaders and teachers: fire and wind, broad knowledge, the will to protect others.
clan.noirm.kaguya.desc: Warriors who shape their own bones: very tough, hard-hitting. Some of the line carry a wasting illness.
clan.noirm.hozuki.desc: Bodies that turn to water: near water, blows pass through them. Frail when dry.
clan.noirm.yuki.desc: The Ice bloodline: wind and water fused into ice, fine control and quick movement.
clan.noirm.chinoike.desc: A feared bloodline with blood-red eyes and powerful illusions.
clan.noirm.kurama.desc: Born illusionists whose genjutsu can feel real. Their bodies are often weak.
clan.noirm.fuma.desc: A wandering clan of weapon fighters, distant kin of the Uchiha.
clan.noirm.iburi.desc: A reclusive clan whose bodies turn to smoke: blows can pass through them. Fragile and secretive.
clan.noirm.jugo.desc: Their bodies soak up nature energy: huge strength and healing, but an unstable mind and poor control.
clan.noirm.kamizuru.desc: Bee masters of the Stone: their swarms sense, sting and poison.
clan.noirm.yotsuki.desc: A Cloud clan of powerful bodies and lightning.
clan.noirm.kazekage.desc: The line of the Sand's Kazekage: Magnet Release, sand armour and a strong guard.
clan.noirm.kurogane.desc: A samurai family of the Land of Iron: blades and posture over ninjutsu.
clan.noirm.shimura.desc: A severe, distrusted clan with iron minds and wind.
clan.noirm.hoshigaki.desc: Shark-like giants of the Mist with chakra like a tailed beast's.
clan.noirm.might.desc: A family with almost no ninjutsu who make up for it with taijutsu, stamina and heart.
clan_perks.noirm.vast_chakra.desc: a large chakra pool that refills fast
clan_perks.noirm.tough_bloodline.desc: sturdy bodies that shrug off poison
clan_perks.noirm.keen_senses.desc: sharp eyes and a feel for chakra
clan_perks.noirm.swift_line.desc: fast runners who keep getting faster
clan_perks.noirm.fist_tradition.desc: a family fighting style: harder blows
clan_perks.noirm.herbalists.desc: pills and medicine run in the family
clan_perks.noirm.long_lived.desc: slow to wear out: healing, eyes, pills
creator.noirm.clan.generated: A clan of this world, with its own gifts in the blood.
creator.noirm.clan.jutsu_tip: Secret techniques: every member is born knowing them, and only members can use them.
creator.noirm.clan.talents_note: Talents are yours alone: your clan makes some likelier, but two members can be very different. A reroll rolls them again.
message.noirm.clan.perks_hint: /noirm clan perks shows what your blood gives; /noirm trait list your talents.
message.noirm.clan.hound: A ninja hound bounds up to you: your clan's partner for life.
message.noirm.talents.migrated: Your blood stirs: your clan's gifts awaken and your own talents show themselves.
message.noirm.scroll.kept: Your seal held: the scroll is empty and whole, ready to use again.
message.noirm.jutsu.not_clan: Only that clan's blood can use this technique
command.noirm.trait.unknown: No talent called %s (/noirm trait list all)
help.noirm.clan.perks: what your clan's blood gives (or another clan's), plainly
help.noirm.trait.list: your talents and what each does
help.noirm.trait.reroll: roll your talents again (biased by your clan)
creator.noirm.genetics.see_clan: The Clan tab shows the blood and the talents in full.
tooltip.noirm.hiraishin_kunai: Carries your space-time formula when thrown
tooltip.noirm.space_time_scroll: Read it to learn the Space-Time Formula (CTL %s, Reserves %s)
key.noirm.hiraishin_mark: Flying Raijin: write a mark (sneak: recall kunai)
key.noirm.hiraishin_jump: Flying Raijin: jump to the aimed mark
key.noirm.hiraishin_cycle: Flying Raijin: pick the next mark
screen.noirm.jutsu.behavior.hiraishin: Instant travel to a formula mark
message.noirm.flicker.winded: Too many flickers in a row: catch your breath
message.noirm.hiraishin.formula_needs: The formula slips out of your grasp: it needs CTL %s (you have %s) and Reserves %s (you have %s)
message.noirm.hiraishin.formula_learned: You learn the Space-Time Formula. Write marks (Y), throw marked kunai, mark with your blows: every new mark is practice.
message.noirm.hiraishin.needs_formula: You don't know the Space-Time Formula
message.noirm.hiraishin.not_yet: You can write the marks, but not travel to them yet
message.noirm.hiraishin.raijin_needs: The Flying Raijin: formula ★%s/%s, CTL %s/%s, Reserves %s/%s
message.noirm.hiraishin.raijin_learned: The formula opens: you can travel to your marks. Flying Raijin learned (X to jump).
message.noirm.hiraishin.read: You read the flash: it lands right there!
command.noirm.hiraishin.title: The Flying Raijin
command.noirm.hiraishin.find_scroll: Find or craft a Space-Time Formula scroll to begin
command.noirm.hiraishin.given: Formula and Flying Raijin learned, 16 marked kunai given
command.noirm.hiraishin.legend: A legend of the Flying Raijin stands before you
help.noirm.section.spacetime: Flying Raijin, marks and genjutsu scenes
help.noirm.spacetime.hiraishin: Your road to the Flying Raijin and your marks
help.noirm.spacetime.marks: List your formula marks with distance and time left
help.noirm.spacetime.give: Learn the formula and the Flying Raijin, get 16 marked kunai
help.noirm.spacetime.legend: A legend who fights with the Flying Raijin appears in front of you
help.noirm.spacetime.genjutsu_test: Put yourself (or the targets) in a genjutsu scene
perk.noirm.jinchuriki_pool: With a beast sealed: chakra pool %s
perk.noirm.jinchuriki_pool.desc: A tailed beast sealed inside you adds this much more to your chakra pool.
perk.noirm.rough_control.desc: So much raw chakra is hard to shape: at low chakra control (CTL) jutsu cost this much more and genjutsu lose twice as much power. Training CTL up to 50 makes it go away.
perk.noirm.chakra_beacon.desc: A chakra this big is easy to feel from afar: wild ninjas find you more often, and mobs and beasts notice you from further away.
perk.noirm.gate_mastery.desc: The Gates burn less of your body and close later (at a lower health line).
item.noirm.ninken_contract.desc: Sign it in blood and a puppy answers. Then: summon your hound to your side, or send it home.
item.noirm.hound_pill.desc: For your ninja hound: a short frenzy (its fur flushes red), a little bond and training. Then it's tired for a while.
message.noirm.clan.hound_contract: Your family's ninken summoning contract is in your bag: sign it to call your first hound.
message.noirm.jutsu.needs_hound: Your hound must be near, awake and grown enough
message.noirm.hound.puppy: A ninja hound puppy tumbles up to you: meet %s, your partner for life.
message.noirm.hound.summoned_first: Smoke, a yip, and %s answers the contract: your first ninken.
message.noirm.hound.down: %s is knocked out (%ss). Feed it to wake it sooner.
message.noirm.hound.still_down: Still knocked out (%ss). Food, a bone or a pill wakes it.
message.noirm.hound.lost: %s is gone for now. It will find its way back to you in %ss.
message.noirm.hound.pill: %s gulps the pill: its fur bristles red.
message.noirm.hound.dismissed: %s goes home in a puff of smoke.
message.noirm.hound.too_small: Your hound must be a great hound, near and awake.
message.noirm.hound.too_young_guard: %s is too young to guard alone (from %s): it sits and waits.
message.noirm.hound.litter: %s trusts you: their hound's litter has a puppy for you.
command.noirm.hound.bad_stage: Stages: puppy, young, grown, great, giant
command.noirm.hound.no_room: There's no room for a puppy here.
help.noirm.hound.status: your hound: stage, bond, XP, what the next stage needs
help.noirm.hound.order: give your hound an order (also on the hound panel, O)
help.noirm.hound.stage: grow or shrink your hound to a stage
help.noirm.hound.bond: set your bond with your hound
help.noirm.hound.remove: send your hound away for good
screen.noirm.hound.none_desc: You have no ninja hound. The Inuzuka are born beside one; the Hatake keep a summoning contract; anyone else might, one day, be given a puppy by an Inuzuka friend who trusts them.
screen.noirm.hound.none_contract: Your family keeps a ninken summoning contract. Sign it (use it from your bag) to call your first hound.
screen.noirm.hound.stage.puppy.desc: Small enough to ride on your head or in your jacket. Big head, short legs, a nose already sharper than any eye.
screen.noirm.hound.stage.young.desc: Gangly and fast: legs first, head last. Big enough to spin beside you in Fang Over Fang.
screen.noirm.hound.stage.grown.desc: A lean wolf-hound in its red scarf: a real fighter that can hold a post on its own.
screen.noirm.hound.stage.great.desc: Taller at the shoulder than a horse: you ride it into battle. The Inuzuka can fuse with it into the Two-Headed Wolf.
screen.noirm.hound.stage.giant.desc: A legend of the kennels: huge, scarred, with a nose that reaches across a battlefield.
screen.noirm.hound.growth.desc: A hound grows when three things are far enough along: its own XP (fights and training beside you), your bond (time together, food, petting, fights) and your own power (speed and taijutsu). It grows as you do.
screen.noirm.hound.top: Fully grown: nothing is left to grow.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.smell.desc: Smells hidden and invisible enemies within %s blocks, marks them with a glow and growls a warning. Order 'track' and it leads you to a scent.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.marking.desc: A jutsu: your hound dashes to the target and marks it with its scent. You both hit it harder, and it can't hide.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.carry.desc: Rides on your head or peeks out of your jacket (right-click it, or the buttons below). Blows meant for it hit you.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.fang.desc: Cast Fang Over Fang and your hound spins into a drill beside you: the two drills cross on your target. Alone, it's Passing Fang.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.clone.desc: Inuzuka blood: your hound takes your shape and fights like a beast until the clone breaks.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.guard.desc: Old enough to hold a spot on its own and fight whatever comes near it.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.ride.desc: Climb on its back (right-click). Jump to leap; it carries you faster than a horse.
screen.noirm.hound.ability.wolf.desc: Inuzuka blood: fuse with your great hound into a giant two-headed wolf. Fang Over Fang becomes Fang Wolf Fang.
screen.noirm.hound.order.follow.desc: Stay at my side (it catches up by itself, even across worlds).
screen.noirm.hound.order.sit.desc: Sit and stay here (it still defends itself).
screen.noirm.hound.order.guard.desc: Hold this spot and fight anything hostile that comes near (grown hounds).
screen.noirm.hound.order.attack.desc: Go for the enemy I'm looking at.
screen.noirm.hound.order.track.desc: Follow an enemy's scent and lead me there (the one I look at, or the nearest).
screen.noirm.hound.order.pet.desc: A good scratch behind the ears (a little bond, now and then).
screen.noirm.hound.order.carry.desc: Up on your head (press again to put it down).
screen.noirm.hound.order.jacket.desc: Tucked in your jacket, its head out at the collar.
screen.noirm.hound.order.recall.desc: Send it home through the contract (it keeps everything it learned).
screen.noirm.hound.order.summon.desc: Call it to your side through the contract (costs some chakra).
screen.noirm.hound.state.head: On your head
